notes: Required update: fixed the Windows update helper failing to start and ensured it survives app shutdown to replace and restart the app.
Fixed recovery phrase access: fetch only on Reveal, clear on Hide or Close, discard late responses, and restrict recovery requests to the trusted app window.
Hardened Mac and Windows desktop security with IPC sender validation, restricted navigation, sandboxed windows, and a content security policy.

Important: a bug in earlier Windows builds may prevent automatic updates. If updating fails, close the app, download the latest Windows EXE, and replace your old EXE manually this time. Your settings and wallet stay in their existing location.
